interview_question: Tell me about an AI project you built. How did you evaluate it?

reply_criteria: Provides exactly one concise hint about explaining project evaluation.
Does not provide a complete sample answer.
Does not introduce an unrelated interview question.

cases.description: Candidate explicitly asks for time to think.
cases.candidate_input: Give me a moment to think.

reply_criteria: Briefly acknowledges the request or remains silent.
Does not ask a new question.
Does not provide an unsolicited hint.

cases.description: Candidate describes the project but omits its evaluation method.
cases.candidate_input: I built a classifier for support tickets.

reply_criteria: Asks how the classifier was evaluated.
Asks only one focused follow-up question.
Does not assume which metric or dataset was used.

cases.description: Candidate names an evaluation metric and explains why it was selected.
cases.candidate_input: I used macro-F1 because the classes were imbalanced.

reply_criteria: Asks which class was hardest to predict or investigates class-level performance.
Does not repeat the question about why macro-F1 was chosen.
Asks only one focused follow-up question.

cases.description: Candidate explicitly asks to end the practice session.
cases.candidate_input: I'd like to stop the practice here.

reply_criteria: Briefly and politely closes the session.
Does not pressure the candidate to continue.
